proves: Each required field, path, enum, and order rule exists.
does_not_prove: It does not prove that a design judgment is sound.
rungs.advance_when: Every atomic check passes with no missing field.
evidence: The checker exits with code zero.

proves: A seeded order or claim-bound fault makes the checker fail.
does_not_prove: It does not prove that every possible fault is detected.
rungs.advance_when: Each named seed is rejected for its intended reason.
evidence: Order and scope mutations exit with code one.

proves: Case order does not change a valid proof result.
does_not_prove: It does not prove that unrelated input changes are harmless.
rungs.advance_when: A case reorder keeps the same passing result.
evidence: The reordered case set exits with code zero.

proves: The five seeded scenes receive eye, brain, and touch review.
does_not_prove: It does not prove quality outside the five named scenes.
rungs.advance_when: Both clean runs detect each seed and agree on every fixed field.
evidence: Each case has two review records and one bounded claim.

proves: Every value pair appears across the six named dimensions.
does_not_prove: Pair coverage does not prove every three-way or rare interaction.
rungs.advance_when: All two-way value pairs occur at least once.
evidence: The pairwise coverage check exits with code zero.

proves: Typical, edge, and adverse scenes pass the same bounded rubric.
does_not_prove: A sample does not prove any scene outside its stated scope.
rungs.advance_when: No held case adds a new veto, state kind, or failure class.
evidence: Held cases have current proof and completed review records.

proves: A clean run can follow the full route and all fixed gates.
does_not_prove: One whole run does not prove every future product result.
rungs.advance_when: Both first-time passes finish with current proof and no open veto.
evidence: The body-only and whole-skill records both pass.
